classification_reason: Drawn by the user and supplied directly as the shape target. Held at REFERENCE with the rest of the beret family until the family is cleared for shipping; it is not third-party art and carries no licence question of its own.
attribution: drawn by the user; ingested to index colours here

construction.ingested: pixels read from the source PNGs; no ASCII transcription and no resampling
construction.geometry: ACCEPTED AND FROZEN by the user as one beret shape variant. A fit refinement that narrowed it toward beret_01's proportions was written and reverted: the silhouette is not to be tuned further. Wear quality is addressed through shading and material instead.

interior_detail.rule: an 8-connected blob of non-lightest cells touching neither the outline nor the exterior; found geometrically, not by colour name

construction.shading: NOT taken from the source. The sheet's four reds are its own shading; the project has its own. Outline -> rim step 2, everything it encloses -> flat body step 4, with interior form left to the palette ramp, the material treatment axis and decals.
construction.front: an ARCH -- the hat has a head opening cut through it, outlined along the underside, with a short leg each side. Four earlier passes drew it as a closed dome.
construction.back: a full disc; nothing occludes it from behind
construction.side: deliberately asymmetric -- high at the front, draping down and back. `left` is mirrored from it at render time.
construction.vertical_registration: each view at its own drawn offset -- front 3, side 2, back 0. Top-aligning all three instead was tried and rejected by the in-game capture: it hung the back disc 2.5 rows below the head.
